soundHint: The voice comes from your browser. Which languages are available depends on your device.
soundMissing: No voice for this language is installed on your device. Subtitles still work.
draftNote: Draft: recording of the real app with test data. Subtitles machine-translated.
whatLabel: What it is, what it does and how to use it.

cues.c1: Welcome to the training: first steps. Everything you see is the real app with test data.
cues.c2: The navigation is on the left. Every area of the app has an entry here.
cues.c3: Step 1: Check under "Integrations" which services are connected.
cues.c4: Each row shows the real, verified status – never a faked connection.
cues.c5: "Not configured" means this service has not been set up yet. Without an AI provider, the app works in template mode.
cues.c6: Step 2: Enter your brand under "Brand DNA". Tone, audience and values flow into every generated text.
cues.c7: Example: fill in industry and target audience, then save at the bottom.
cues.c8: Step 3: Generate your first idea under "Ideas & Inspiration". Enter a topic and click "Generate ideas".
cues.c9: The ideas appear as cards. In template mode they are examples; with an AI provider they become tailored to you.
cues.c10: Everything stays a draft until you approve it. Every area has its own explainer video.

cues.c1: The dashboard is your home page: an overview of everything happening in your workspace.
cues.c2: At the top you see active agents, content production and scheduled posts.
cues.c3: Further down you find the latest activity and shortcuts to Content Factory and Brand DNA.
cues.c4: Use "Week" to change the period of the figures.
cues.c5: How to use it: open the dashboard daily, check open drafts and jump straight to the right area from here.

cues.c1: The training section is your guide inside the app. It explains every area step by step.
cues.c2: Each topic has a description, numbered steps and a link that opens the matching page.
cues.c3: These explainer videos appear here too, one for each area.
cues.c4: How to use it: pick a topic, read the steps, open the page and try it right away.

cues.c1: The Content Factory is the workbench for all your content items in one place.
cues.c2: Function: create, duplicate and rewrite items, enrich them with voiceover and subtitles and run them through the approval workflow.
cues.c3: The filters at the top show the statuses: Draft, In review, Approved, Scheduled, Published and Archived.
cues.c4: How to: use "New content item" to create an item.
cues.c5: Open an item to edit script, voiceover, subtitles, hashtags and thumbnail.
cues.c6: Approval is always a manual step. Nothing is published without your confirmation.

cues.c1: Here you collect ideas: topic clusters, series and formats for upcoming content.
cues.c2: Function: the IdeaAgent generates ideas for a topic, or you add your own by hand.
cues.c3: How to: enter a topic, choose platform, goal and format and click "Generate ideas".
cues.c4: Each idea becomes a card with title, hook and priority.
cues.c5: Use "Manual" to add your own idea.
cues.c6: Take good ideas as the starting point for the Content Brain.

cues.c1: The Content Brain turns one idea into a complete content plan.
cues.c2: Function: it takes your Brand DNA into account and creates hooks, scripts, hashtags and thumbnail concepts as drafts for every chosen platform.
cues.c3: How to: enter the topic and the target audience.
cues.c4: Choose goal and language, then click the platforms. Here, TikTok is added.
cues.c5: The slider sets how many content items are created per platform.
cues.c6: One click on "Generate content plan" starts the run.
cues.c7: The campaign appears below. All items are drafts and are stored in the Content Factory.

cues.c1: The Brand DNA describes your brand: name, industry, target audience, tone and values.
cues.c2: Function: this information flows automatically into the Content Brain and the script, hook and hashtag agents.
cues.c3: How to: fill in the fields, for example industry and target audience.
cues.c4: Further down you maintain preferred and forbidden words, calls to action and brand values.

cues.c1: The Script Studio is the workshop for scripts and hooks.
cues.c2: Function: it builds scripts using the structure hook, problem, value, example, payoff and call to action and delivers several hook variants.
cues.c3: How to: enter a topic and choose the platform.
cues.c4: Then click "Generate script & hooks".
cues.c5: The result is a draft that you continue to use in the Content Factory.

cues.c1: The Voice Studio manages voices and creates voiceovers.
cues.c2: Function: maintain the voice library, create previews and import voices. The connection runs via ElevenLabs.
cues.c3: How to: add a voice manually or import it from ElevenLabs. The import needs a configured connection.
cues.c4: With a text and a voice you create a preview and play it.

cues.c1: The Video Studio is the video pipeline of the app.
cues.c2: Function: format manager, interchangeable video providers and connection of voiceover and subtitles.
cues.c3: The page shows which providers are set up. Providers that are not set up are honestly marked as such.
cues.c4: How to: you create videos per content item in the Content Factory.

cues.c1: The Design Studio delivers thumbnail concepts and image assets.
cues.c2: Function: the thumbnail agent suggests title, visual idea, text and layout. The Canva integration is planned here.
cues.c3: How to: enter the topic for the thumbnail.
cues.c4: Click "Generate concept".
cues.c5: The concept serves as a template for your image.

cues.c1: Here you connect your platform accounts and see their status.
cues.c2: Function: access is managed on the server and stored encrypted. You sign in to the platform via Composio.
cues.c3: Each card shows platform, account, status and the last read test.
cues.c4: "Not set up yet" means the operator has not yet activated the connection on the server.
cues.c5: How to: once set up, click "Connect" on the platform and sign in. It only reads, nothing is published.

cues.c1: The Content Calendar shows scheduled and published content at a glance.
cues.c2: Function: all content items with a publishing date appear here, filterable by platform.
cues.c3: How to: schedule an item with a date in the Content Factory, then it appears here.
cues.c4: Before every publication the app checks live whether the target platform is connected.

cues.c1: Analytics shows your performance figures.
cues.c2: Function: only data that really exists, imported or entered by you. Nothing is made up.
cues.c3: You see the trend over time, the best performing content and recommendations from the Learning Agent.
cues.c4: How to: as soon as platforms are connected or you enter data, the charts fill up.

cues.c1: The Growth page gives recommendations for more reach.
cues.c2: Function: from your real analytics data it calculates the best posting times, successful hashtags and formats.
cues.c3: How to: choose a platform and read the recommendations.
cues.c4: These are recommendations, not automation. Followers or interactions are never artificially boosted.

cues.c1: Under Revenue you bring together your earnings across platforms and campaigns.
cues.c2: Function: amounts only appear once you enter them. There are no made-up numbers.
cues.c3: How to: click "Record revenue", choose platform and type and enter the amount.
cues.c4: Payouts always happen directly through the platform. SECRET 58 does not process payouts.

cues.c1: "Sales & Shop" shows your own business revenue.
cues.c2: Function: it is separate from your SECRET 58 plan. Only actual sales are counted, test data is marked.
cues.c3: At the top are the totals per currency, below that your provider details for the legal notice.
cues.c4: Option B: sell via SECRET 58. Option A: import an existing shop.
cues.c5: How to: fill in and save your provider details, then choose the sales route.

cues.c1: Here you add the website assistant to your own website.
cues.c2: Function: the assistant answers your visitors' questions.
cues.c3: We do not change your website automatically. You add the code yourself or have your web designer add it.
cues.c4: How to: enter your web address and click "Add website".
cues.c5: Then copy the code shown into your website.

cues.c1: The inbox collects messages and comments across all platforms.
cues.c2: Function: the MessageAgent suggests replies. Only what you approve is sent.
cues.c3: How to: as long as no platform is connected live, click "Simulate conversation".
cues.c4: Check the suggested reply, adjust it and approve it.

cues.c1: The Agent Monitor shows all SECRET 58 agents.
cues.c2: Function: status, last task and result of every agent. Every run is logged.
cues.c3: The run history shows what ran when and whether it worked.
cues.c4: How to use it: check here when something was not created as expected.

cues.c1: Here you see the live status of all external services.
cues.c2: Function: every row is based on the access that is actually set. There are no faked connections.
cues.c3: The groups are: AI providers, voice, social platforms, design, video and trends.
cues.c4: How to: for "Not configured", "Get API key" leads to the provider's page.
cues.c5: External providers have their own prices. Each service shows which model applies.

cues.c1: Under "Plan & billing" you see your plan and can change it.
cues.c2: Function: the AI features run through the operator's access. You do not need your own AI subscription.
cues.c3: There are Pro and Maxi, monthly or yearly. The prices are shown net on the cards.
cues.c4: A purchase only happens with an explicit click on "Order with obligation to pay".
cues.c5: If you have a promo code, redeem it in the field below.

cues.c1: In Settings you manage workspace, users and system information.
cues.c2: Function: workspace, roles, system status, setup assistant and your data with access and deletion.
cues.c3: How to: scroll through the sections. Deleting the workspace requires an additional confirmation.
cues.c4: Check your data and the setup assistant here regularly.
